def transform(grid):
    # Combine the two binary masks by set union, then map any occupied cell to 3.
    sep = next(i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if all(v == 4 for v in row))
    top, bottom = grid[:sep], grid[sep+1:]
    return [[3 if top[r][c] or bottom[r][c] else 0 for c in range(len(top[0]))] for r in range(len(top))]
